answer: An AI-agent economy can require each identity to lock a bond and build reputation through verified work receipts, while valuable jobs need endorsements from older, active agents. Random audits compare claims with outcomes; agents forming a suspicious mirror network lose their bonds when fraud is proven. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake, wait for history, and risk forfeiting a lagoon of collateral, making mass identity creation costly. Each honest agent helps maintain the garden.
